description: The image displays three pie charts illustrating human pairwise comparison results across three distinct datasets — “Truthful Review,” “Funny Reddit,” and “Unhealthy Comments” — from the paper “On the Role of Model Prior in Real-World Inductive Reasoning.” Each chart is divided into three segments representing preferences: “W/o Demos” (gray), “Hard to Tell” (blue), and “W/ Demos” (teal), as indicated by the legend at the top. In “Truthful Review,” 43.0% of comparisons favored hypotheses without demos, 22.9% were hard to tell, and 34.1% favored those with demos. For “Funny Reddit,” 41.5% preferred without demos, 21.5% were hard to tell, and 37.1% favored with demos. In “Unhealthy Comments,” 37.8% preferred without demos, 27.4% were hard to tell, and 34.8% favored with demos. All charts include percentage labels within each slice, and the segments are visually ordered by size in descending order clockwise from the top-left segment. No slices are exploded or emphasized beyond their proportional size.
